fato_historico: 1929: The 1929 Palestine riots break out in Mandatory Palestine between Palestinian Arabs and Jews and continue until the end of the month. In total, 133 Jews and 116 Arabs are killed.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how cycles of history remind us of the fragility of peace. Much like a delicate four-leaf clover hidden in a field, harmony is something to be nurtured with intention. It may be a good time to focus on reconciling conflicting emotions within yourself, seeking balance and understanding amidst the noise of the outside world.
frase_do_dia: True peace begins within the quiet garden of your own heart today.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of shifting perspectives and personal growth.
conselho: Practice mindful breathing to soothe your spirit and invite clarity into your day.
